description: A classic cru-blended Barolo from one of Piedmont's benchmark houses, raised in large casks in the traditional manner. Dried roses and violets lift over red cherry and a hint of baking spice; the palate is fine-boned and structured, dried-herb and leather notes threading through mouthwatering tannin and vibrant acidity.
sommelierNotes: Decant an hour ahead and serve at cellar temperature with braised beef, truffle, mushroom risotto, or an aged hard cheese.
aroma: Dried roses, violets, red cherry and fine baking spice
palate: Structured red fruit with dried basil, a kiss of leather and vibrant acidity
